question: Does M-479 materially improve the M-2104 700-034 versus 700-004 count-compound hypothesis, or only expose duplicate-family risk?

source_result.plate: CISI Collections in India, IA leaf n150, printed p. 115, MOHENJO-DARO 478-481 tablets in bas-relief

adjudication.strongest_support: CISI India source imagery directly shows M-479 A/B on the M-478-481 tablet plate, and the M-479 A crop has a boxable four-stroke group adjacent to a U/pot-like cluster region matching the local +400-097-700-004+ family.
adjudication.strongest_downgrade: M-479 is same site, same type, same material, same direction, same full local text, same source plate cluster, and adjacent catalogue family as M-478/M-480. It is family-internal support, not an extra independent recurrence.
adjudication.safe_claim: M-479 has been acquired and stored as a source-visible local extra comparator for the 097-700-004 side. It keeps the M-2104 count-compound hypothesis alive as a visual target but does not license 004=four, 034=three, or any translation claim.
